stats.label: Time to refocus after email interruption

blocks.text: Managing your ticket volume on Mac

Your day as a technical support specialist centers on ticket management. You likely juggle 30 to 50 tickets every shift. Each ticket requires accurate logging in your platform. Switching between your ticketing system and your terminal or remote desktop tool creates friction. Use Lazur to dictate notes directly into your ticket forms. Hold the fn key to start dictation. Speak your resolution steps clearly. Lazur types the text at your cursor position instantly.
Remote support software help and screen navigation

When you use apps like Splashtop or Jump Desktop, you often need to find specific settings quickly. If you forget a menu path, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where a setting is. Lazur draws a circle around the menu item. This prevents you from hunting through menus while a user waits. It keeps your remote session professional and efficient.
Reducing email interruptions in IT support

Email is a constant source of distraction. Every interruption costs you over 23 minutes of focus. To handle this, use Lazur to draft responses without leaving your current task. Ask Lazur to draft an email reply based on your notes. You can then review and send the text. This keeps your hands on your keyboard and your eyes on your active ticket.
Technical documentation and knowledge base growth

Building a knowledge base is vital for your team. Use Lazur to capture your troubleshooting steps as you perform them. You can dictate the exact terminal commands or configuration paths. This ensures your documentation is accurate and reflects real world solutions. Always follow your employer rules regarding data privacy when documenting client issues. Do not include sensitive user data in your notes.

You likely use tools like Terminal or Proxyman daily. Opening these apps manually takes time. Use voice commands to open your most used tools. Say "Open Terminal" or "Open Proxyman" to launch them instantly. You can also ask Lazur to explain specific command line flags if you are unsure. This saves you from switching to a browser to look up manual pages.
Handling research tasks in the background

Complex issues often require research. Instead of stopping your work to search for answers, ask Lazur to research a topic. Lazur uses background Chrome tabs to find the information. It returns a summary report. You can read this while you continue your current ticket. This is a powerful way to manage multiple workstreams without losing your place.

faq.question: Can Lazur control my remote support apps?
faq.answer: Lazur does not click buttons or operate remote support apps. It guides you by pointing at items or explaining how to find settings. You retain full control of the interaction.

faq.question: Is my data private when using voice commands?
faq.answer: Lazur only listens or looks at your screen while you hold the shortcut. Audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers for processing and are not stored or used to train models.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is currently available for macOS only. Support for Windows is planned for the future.
